descriptionChirho: A male person who practices sexual immorality; one who engages in illicit sexual relations. Used in NT vice lists and exclusion catalogs (1 Cor 5-6, Eph 5, Heb 12-13, Rev 21-22). Uniformly rendered: Spanish 'fornicario/fornicarios', Hindi 'vyabhichaari' (व्यभिचारी), Arabic 'zunaat' (الزُّناةُ) and 'zanin' (زانٍ), Korean 'eumhaeng-haneun ja' (음행하는 자), Swahili 'mwasherati/wazinzi'. The three clusters differ only in grammatical number and case (singular nominative vs plural dative/accusative) with no semantic distinction.
